job.title: PRN CNA
job.description:
Caring Companions' PRN CNA Team is for CNAs who want flexible, as-needed work in Springfield and southwest Missouri. PRN Team shifts pay $20 an hour.

You tell us the days and times you're generally available and how much notice you need. When a qualifying open shift comes up, we contact you first, and you choose whether to take it. There's no minimum.

If you'd also like an ongoing, regularly scheduled client, you can take one too. Ongoing scheduled shifts are paid at $18 an hour, and you stay on the PRN Team for pickups at $20.

Apply in under two minutes. We keep this team open all year.

Qualifications

  • A current CNA certification
  • A driver's license and reliable transportation
  • At least a year of caregiving experience
  • Able to pass a background check and references
